---
title: "lua-env Example"
subtitle: "Quarto Extension"
author:
  - name: "Mickaël CANOUIL, _Ph.D._"
    orcid: "0000-0002-3396-4549"
    url: "https://mickael.canouil.fr"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
filters:
  # pre-quarto, not post-quarto: Quarto expands shortcodes during its own pass,
  # so a filter placed after it publishes the metadata too late.
  - path: lua-env
    at: pre-quarto
extensions:
  lua-env:
    json: false
---

The filter collects the live Pandoc and Quarto Lua objects into metadata, and the shortcode prints any of them by a dot-separated path.

```markdown
{{{< lua-env pandoc.FORMAT >}}}
```

This document renders to {{< lua-env pandoc.FORMAT >}}, under Pandoc {{< lua-env pandoc.PANDOC_VERSION >}} and Quarto {{< lua-env quarto.version >}}.

The same values are reachable as ordinary metadata, under the `lua-env` key:

```markdown
{{{< meta lua-env.pandoc.FORMAT >}}}
```

{{< meta lua-env.pandoc.FORMAT >}}

Set `json: true` to write the whole tree to `lua-env.json` beside the output.

Full documentation: <https://m.canouil.dev/quarto-lua-env/>.
